title: Surface authoritative source freshness and degradation in the already authorized Command Work Queue
goal: Implement bounded Class-0 per-item source freshness and view degradation from explicit versioned owner metadata, without inventing staleness thresholds or mutating source objects.
invariants: Read-only Command Incident/Task source freshness only after the original first-party Owner.CanRead checks in Project and tenant/environment verification.
Owner-supplied source health, observed UTC timestamp, and EXPLICIT versioned aging/stale thresholds; no hardcoded universal time policy or use of Incident UpdatedAt as source observation time.
Unversioned/absent/future-clock policy yields unknown, source-unavailable/partial are explicit owner states and do not imply guessed freshness.
Only items accepted into the current canonical view/status filter may contribute source-degradation diagnostics; six views, 50 displayed rows, and one GET route unchanged.
Absent optional owner freshness metadata preserves preexisting JSON row field set and no new host IAM, Shared Saved Views, data store, network endpoint, paid service or unsafe mutation.
security_properties: Do not surface any source metadata until owner authorization for the exact Incident/Task; denied or foreign tenants never leak owner source IDs.
Validate owner source labels and policy version at the boundary; reject malformed authoritative metadata before any result is returned.
HTML escapes source names and policy fields with html/template and continues no-store/CSP; no new JavaScript.
A missing freshness policy cannot produce current/stale from guessed thresholds and a degraded item outside filter cannot degrade the selected view.

migration.rationale: Optional owner metadata and omitempty JSON field, no persisted schema or mutation.

rollback.strategy: Remove optional SourceFreshness/Row.Freshness, freshness.go and read-only HTML freshness cell while keeping all CAP-CMD-101 queue views/selection.
verification: Old work queue JSON remains unchanged for providers without source metadata.

inputs: Canonical CAP-CMD-109 full §§1–27 and CAP-CMD-101 full §§1–27, module README and Incident/Task canonical ownership.
Existing first-party trusted Owner.List/CanRead work-queue Project, six views/sort/status/selected context (frozen PR #163 HEAD b5e71280e2af3960cf63f45fea92a71cff557a68).
Host source metadata optional; host source policy version and thresholds authoritative. Other Shared/Settings health and background Jobs remain separate.
outputs: An authorized owner-source freshness projection with explicit state, source, observed_at and optional policy version, rendered in existing Work Queue HTML and opt-in per-row JSON only when metadata is present.
Explicit partial-sources diagnostic for actually displayed source-unavailable or partial items; no clock-derived state without host policy.
acceptance_tests: For owner-allowed Incident/Task, versioned 60/120-second example policy yields current/aging/stale with deterministic relative event times; no policy or future source clock yields unknown.
Explicit source-unavailable or partial health is displayed in selected view and changes view state to partial-sources; filtered-out source outage does not degrade unrelated view.
Denial/cross-tenant owner rows expose no source IDs; malformed authorized owner metadata fails before response.
Browser contextual escaping for malicious authorized source name, legacy metadata-free JSON unchanged, six views/status/sort/selection remain operational.
Exact HEAD command-work-queue-runtime multi-OS and mandatory engineering-kernel checks, one independent read-only L2 after material delivery.

performance_budget.rationale: No new owner requests: one O(1) age calculation and bounded metadata projection per already authorized row, <=5000 input, <=50 displayed.
metrics: Single UTC now per queue projection.
One bounded freshness state evaluation per authorized Item.

definition_of_ready: E10-SCALE-005B VERIFIED in work graph, Command module CAP-CMD-109 is canonically defined; explicit host policy optional and missing policy remains unknown.
Independent CAP-CMD-109 ownership; reuses CAP-CMD-101 read-only route and security without claiming its full acceptance or making Shared health/policy decisions.
Frozen git parent #163 final SHA b5e71280e2af3960cf63f45fea92a71cff557a68; two workflows SUCCESS but L2 report unavailable; do not change frozen ancestor.
definition_of_done: Source/time/policy freshness statuses and degraded view behavior in Command Work Queue, implemented in one bounded task under new Command freshness epic.
Exact HEAD runtime/engineering CI verified, single independent read-only L2 scheduled only once for material newly exposed source metadata.
No production provider SLA contract, definitive tenant thresholds, follow-up jobs, Incident Detail, Shared Saved Views, approval or merge claimed.
